Nga bub ha khmat jong phi kum ban pynkynmaw la ki sap ki 
phong, ki dustur ki riti, ki jait ki khong, bad ki ’riewkhraw jong ka jait 
bynriew ban la loh buh jingmut lem. Ki Khua Ki Keiew U Hynniew 
Trap kat kum ka khana tynrai, lyngba ki parom Barim Bajah, ngi tip 
ba U Trai Nongthaw Nongbuh u la ai ha ki Longshwa Manshwa ki 5Ji 
ki Kong kulong kumah jong ngi ia kane ka RI U SOHPET BNfcNG. 

La pyrshang mynta ban lum shi jaka ia ki jmgtip bad dang ioh 
kynshew dang tang shiphew lynnong. Ka jait bynriew Hyniiiew Trep 
ka long kaba khraw, kaba la law bha ha ka pyrkhat pyrdain bad ki ju 
long ki ’riew shlur. Ki don la ka Geography bad ka History jong ki ka 
long kaba la myndai bah. Kumta lah ban lum thup shaphang jong ki 
wat da ki spah bad hajar lynnong sla, lada baroh baroh ngi iasei la u 
lyngka. Id shniaht u 'nembah ban tih la ki par jingtip shaphang la ka ri 
bad ka jait bynriew. Ngi don ka daw ban sngew sarong haba ngi 
kyrtiang dien la ka mynnor bad ngin laid heh mynsiem ban ialam ia la 
ki pateng ban dang wan sha ka hok ka jingshisha. Ngim don kam iano 
iano ba kin pynbatai lem shaphang ka thymmei jong ngi — hynrei dei 
ma ngi ki ban pynshai ia ki nongwei nongar u dkhar u lyngkien, lada ki 
kwah tip shaphang Ki Khan Ki Keiew U Hynniew Trep. 

Ha ka liang ki kur ki jait, la pyrshang ban lum ban lang katba 
lah ban tip. Napdeng ki jait ba la kyntiew bad pyni ha ka lynnong 
“Ki kur ki jait” la shem hadien ba don ki jait ba dang jah, wat la ki 
iadon jait don kur mynta. Kumta kum ka jingiathuh sdang, ki jait 
Lyngdoh Thaiang ki jait Syiem Nongkhap bad jait Syiem Thaiang ki 
dei ki jait Hynniew Trep paka wat la kim shym don ha katei ka 
lynnong. Kyrmen yn lah ban pynjanai la kane ka jingpyrshang da ka 
jinglasnoh kti lang baroh ha ki por ban dang wan .

KI R1TI KI DUSTUR U HYNfttEW TREP 

Ki khun ki ksiew u Hynniew Trep Hynniew Skum ki long ka 
jail bynriew kaba kyrpang kaba don la ka nongrim tynrai lajong. La 
pynneh i'a kine ki nongrim tynrai lyngba ki riti ki dustur kiba long ki 
rukom im ka jait bynriew jong ngi naduh ki sngi barim. Ka jait 
bynriew kaba shai ha kano kano ka bynta jong ka pyrthei, ka don la 
u jong u diengkot ban thew i'a ka long rynleng ka jait bynriew da ka 
dustur jong ka. Bunsien la ju lap ba ka jait bynriew kaba duk ba ka 
liang ka riti dustur bad nongrim tynrai (culture) ka shah nguid noh ha 
kiwei pat. Ngi ki longdien Hynniew Trep ngi donbok shi katdei eh 
ba ki longshwa ki la buh la ka riti ka dustur kaba skhem ha ki longdien 
ban bud bad pynneh. 

U khun bynriew shisnieh pyrthei u iasyr'iiem dur i'a ka 
’per syniew ba bun ki rong. Lada uwei u jait syntiew u duh noh, ka 
ji ngi tynnad jong ka kper ka nang blad bad nang lip rong. U Trai 
Nongthaw, ngi ngeit u don la ka jingthmu haba u buh byariew katne 
ha la ki rukom ba u la thmu Kumta ka long ka kamram jong ngi ki 
longdien ban pynneh i'a ki riti ki dustur tynrai ban skhem ka jait 
bynriew Hynniew Trep Hynniew Skum. 

Ka Riti dustur ka iai neh da ki rukom leh bad jingbuddien jong 
ka ia ka nongrim jong ka ri bad ka jait bynriew. Lah ban phiah la ka 
riti bad dustur ha ki bun bynta jong ka jingim kaba ka jait bynriew 
jong ngi ka ju bat naduh ki sngi barim ba jah. To ngin shim mynta 
tang shaphang ka Ri U Hynniew Trep, ki briew, ka rukom pyn'iaid 
khyndew. ka rukom kren ha ka ktien ka thylliej, ka synshar khadar, 
ka niam bad kiwei. Kine ki long ki jinglongtynrai jong ka kaba ki 
longshwa ki la saiiidur bad ki khlem i'apan kylliang ne shah hikai ha 
kiwei pat. Haba shu ong lyngkot k.t ktien riti dustur ka mut ka jingstad 
kyrpang jong ka jait bynriew, kaba pyni la ka sap nylla jong ha bapaw 
shabar ha khmat ka pvrthei.

Ka Ktien Khasi 

La ju i'aiap ba ka ktien Khasi ha la ka kren Sohra, Nongkrem, 
Jwai, Arnwi ter ter ka long kum ka devvlynnong ha kane ka thain. 
Ngim don jingi'adei ei ei rub ha ka ktien ka thylliej bad ki marjan

Ki Khun ki ksiew u Hynniew Trep Hynniew Skum ki long kiba 
riewspah ha ka liang ki kur ki jait. Kine ki jait ki khong ki wan da ka 
daw bad la pynskhem i'a ki da ka niam tynrai U Hynniew Trep. Ngi 
ngeit ba ki kur ki jait ki mih na ka lawbei tynrai kaba long ka kmie 
nyngkong jong kawei pa kawei ka kur ha ka jait bynriew Hynniew Trep. 
U shongkha ba nyngkong eh jong ka kur la khot kyrteng u Thawlang

Ngi burom ia ka longkur ka longkha. bad la bynshet ia ka

dei ki longkmie ha ki khun ki kti bad ki longkha ha ki khun ki para
